rationale_one_line: peerd is a bold anti-backend launch, so MANIFESTO carries the single thesis, and Sentry's violet-and-lime debug-console palette reads as a different production from the recent dark cyan and green mono runs.
writing_tone_notes: Declarative and conviction-first to match the creator's b/acc voice. Praise the architecture, not the feature count. Exact technical claims, zero hype words. Contractions where natural.
do_rules: Lead the story with where the agent runs, not what it can do.
Use the lime accent sparingly, as a single highlight per beat.
Keep the contrast doing the praise: client-side versus everyone else's backend.
dont_rules: No version numbers in the caption.
Do not repeat any scene phrase in the tweet or the Gmail Why-this-one.
